platinum_note: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours to the platinum, one playthrough, no online trophies, cheats disable trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops on its own. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed. Keep cheats off for the whole run: using one disables trophies and saving.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them and pick the easiest; flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going after this pops.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt. Track them under Progress, Activities. Most come up naturally during the story and while working on other trophies, so check the list before hunting the last one down.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. Gold medals here are not too difficult, and the ranges also level up your Focus, which helps Gunslinger. Work through them range by range after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, so you only need one win per location, not every race. Learn each course's line, then win one race at each spot.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you only need half of them. Each win must be at a different location — winning the same race twice does not count twice.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge it leads to.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat all its challenges. Pick the one you like best.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline. It is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. All quests stay available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 1: after the mission Island Dreams he calls, and the green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure chests on the map; dive to the 7 shipwrecks, dig the treasure out of the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last one. All quests stay available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile) are confirmed to count, and more strands are still being found. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. All strands are still available after the story in free-roam.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

sub.label: Strands completed
items: Pilot Pete — The Last Mile strand

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list. It opens automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back in good condition for more pay. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. The cars include the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline. It is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, and the trophy pops when you shut the labs down. Everything stays available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both Jason and Lucia, which needs both characters together after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. MISSABLE: the first meditation only exists in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. The morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept. It is gone after Chapter 1. It is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, but PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations.

sources.name: HowToVideoGame — Where to Find Meditation Spots

sub.label: Meditations done
items: Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house (missable)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, and it unlocks. It cannot be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; it pops once you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the only thing in the game you can lose for good.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops when you start the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also when switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, after Coffee Break.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the only gold tied to the campaign. Finish the final mission and it unlocks. After the credits you return to free-roam, so everything left can still be done.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set. The 100% checklist opens after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, and all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable.

sources.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline. It is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. There are 15 Target Decks to complete for the 100% checklist. Which exact animal pops this trophy is still being confirmed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered around Leonida. You do not need all 18 sets, just three full ones, so pick the sets whose cards you find first and finish those.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on your phone: hold up on the D-pad and then R1 while looking at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture. There are more than 100 to find — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are listed — so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel and it builds up on its own.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress, Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, so leave this for late in the run and then pick the easiest remaining ones. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together: call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle. Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone on the map — the trophy pops when you drive out of it, not when you leave the flashing search area. A fast sports motorcycle helps, and driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County works well because cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Keep the red-and-blue flashing wanted level going the whole time — do not let it drop to the red heat level, and do not let it clear. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items and the back-room safe in each. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not come, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. Use the WAiNK app on your phone, hold up to open it, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops on the way. Track totals under Progress, Vehicles.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, and use Adrenaline to extend it. Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556 assault rifle. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge, which lead straight inside. Go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, at the south end of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons on unfogged map areas. Break in through a back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash in and the vault opens — go in fast and rob it, bringing your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans with purple icons. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so this pops on the way.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier, find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the whole map is visible. It fills in naturally as you travel for other trophies, so check the map late in the run and mop up the foggy corners.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; for this trophy you only need one per gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it pops on the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Partly confirmed: the description is the method — order a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach. No specific venue has been confirmed by a guide yet; PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unknown, while other launch-day lists read the description the same way. Head to the Ocean Beach waterfront, find a bar with a view and order a cocktail.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Resolved after launch: steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and the trophy pops shortly after, once you are out on the street. Only this blue Banshee works — it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but if you miss an item the robbery icon respawns after a while, so it is not missable.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Resolved after launch: have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a membership at a fitness club and always train together — call your partner over, and while one character works out the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then the Strength (heart) stat for each character.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Resolved after launch: perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile, and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent if you keep using excessive violence — avoid that one, since cops shoot on sight more often. It comes naturally while working on other trophies; if you are short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

sources.name: U7Buy — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements Guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Still unconfirmed on launch day two. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. The description — second time's the charm — suggests retrying something that failed once, but no guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Do not chase a guessed method; check back as players report in.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Resolved after launch: this is the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go solo. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path next to the car into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Still unconfirmed on launch day two. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by. Other launch-day lists read the description the same way, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. Try kicking an enemy over while riding past on a motorcycle; if it does not pop, wait for a confirmed method rather than grinding a guess.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills in total — it counts across all robberies, not in one go. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. It builds up naturally over a full playthrough, so check your total late in the run and top it up with a big purchase if you are short.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. They cost $160,000 in total and become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone. Buy them through the phone app. The 4 story-related garages do not count — only the 8 purchasable ones. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need enough garage parking spots first, so buy garages for Little Boxes. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
